_comment: The default avatar of a person without a profile picture (M14a), in the apps and in push notifications (PUSH_NOTIFICATIONS.md §16.1). initials: the trimmed name's first character upper-cased; two letters (the first of the first two words, upper-cased) when the first two words (separated by any Unicode whitespace, the full-width space U+3000 included) both start with an ASCII letter; '?' for an empty name. hue: h = 0; for each UTF-16 unit c of the id: h = (h * 31 + c) mod 2^32; hue = h mod 360. The background is hsl(hue, 55%, 45%) with white bold letters; rgb is that colour in sRGB (0-255, rounded; a client may be 1 off). Hand-written; the desktop, iOS and Android tests read it.
